prompts.armorite_ore: Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. We are correcting a generated inventory icon for identity fidelity, NOT redesigning it. Image 1 is the exact original Armorite Ore / Duralium small pixel sprite. Image 2 is our first generated candidate, which is TOO diagonally tilted and has misplaced pale facets. Image 3 Fire Stone is the existing inventory illustration style reference. Create ONE corrected Duralium icon. Follow image 1 MORE strictly than image 2. Preserve the upright, nearly vertical, squat irregular nugget silhouette, with a small peaked top, slightly stepped side shoulders and bottom tip. Main long axis vertical, not leaning diagonally like candidate 2. Crucial color layout: large near-white/pale pink illuminated facet occupies the TOP CENTER third of the nugget; the CENTRAL and LOWER body is pink-magenta/violet; deepest purple is toward lower right/bottom. Retain the narrow pale outer facets around sides/bottom, but NOT a thick uniform white jewelry bezel. Do not turn it into cut gemstone jewelry, polished oval cabochon, purple egg, crystal cluster or stone with a metal setting. Use only the broad low-detail facets needed to interpret the original; no tiny facets, no texture. Match the Fire Stone's clean smooth game inventory illustration: restrained shaded volume, dark thin contour, upper-left light. The exact original identity matters more than making it elaborate. Centered full object on square real transparent alpha canvas; use ~85 percent canvas height with clean margin; keep all visible and invisible background pixels transparent, no stray flecks. No text, labels, scenery, ground shadow, glow or extra objects. Must read at 48 and32px.
prompts.lure: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one ordinary Lure / Colonia game inventory illustration. Image1 lure.png is the EXACT original identity reference. Image2 is our generated candidate; image3 repel.png is style reference only. Correct candidate2 toward image1, with ONE narrow change: the green bottle body must NOT have a continuous decorative white U-shaped stripe/logo. That U was invented and must disappear. Instead reproduce the tiny sprite's pale angular side/shoulder highlights on the green bottle and its small central pale green glint, as conservative material reflections, not printed decoration. Also keep original mint cap closer to a small round sphere/ball, not a broad mushroom or disc; retain narrow pale neck and short rounded green lower bottle, original relative proportions. Preserve the general clean illustrated finish, colors, upper-left light and thin dark outline of candidate2. The object is the ordinary Lure: no letters, numbers, symbols, atomizer or added mechanisms. Render broad simple shapes readable at 48/32px; avoid fine texture or photorealism. One whole centered object occupying ~85percent squarecanvasheight, genuine transparent alpha background with clean empty margin, no checkerboard, scenery, shadow, text or additionalobjects. Prioritize matching original object over inventing detail.
